summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright, superadmin/nova2024) of Quirófano Fase 1. All 7 requested flows PASS: sidebar items + routes, Insumos/Equipos catalog (create/edit/deactivate, no price field, both tabs), anesthesia types CRUD (Tópica Q300, General Q800, new type Q450 created then deactivated), monthly closure (2026-11 total Q2,500 with 3 cards; 2026-10 closed -> 'Mes cerrado (pagado)' badge, button gone, persists after reload, 2026-11 still open; empty month 2026-12 button disabled), supplies-status for Alquiler (Diego Armando Castillo: pendiente -> registrados, badge 'Insumos: listos' persists after reload; block not shown for IGSS), catalog SELECTs for supply/equipment (no unit-cost field; Viscoelástico x2 and Facoemulsificador added), IGSS detail renders structured block (no regression), new surgery creation (Alquiler/Tópica) works and auto-creates anesthesia record shown in closure. One functional bug: deleting a surgery leaves its anesthesia record (orphan still counted in closure).

critical.issue: Does not delete/void the linked anesthesia_records doc. Reproduced: created TEST surgery (Tópica, TEST_Anest QA) -> Nov closure rose 2500->2800; after DELETE (200) closure stayed 2800 with 'TEST_Anest QA' card. Orphan would be paid at month close. (Tester removed the orphan manually from Mongo.) Same likely for POST /api/surgeries/{id}/cancel (no anesthesia handling in code).

minor.issue: Surgery anesthesia types 'Local' and 'Local Asistida' have no matching type in the catalog, so they show up in closure as 'Local asistida 1 × Q0.00' without any warning. Records with anesthesiologist 'N/A' are counted as a payee ('N/A' card, Q300).

integration_issues.issue: SalaOperaciones uses a hardcoded ANESTHESIA_TYPES list (topica/local/local_asistida/general). It does not come from /api/quirofano/anesthesia/types, so new types created in 'Tipos de anestesia' can't be selected, and Local/Local Asistida get Q0 fees.

issues: Spec says supply cost/total was removed, but the detail still shows Unitario/Total columns, a 'TOTAL:' row and 'Total insumos' in the summary (always Q0.00). The table also still has the 'INSUMOS' cost column.
'Mes cerrado (pagado)' badge renders red text on a blue (primary) background, so contrast is low. The Badge default variant overrides bg-red-100; use variant='outline' or similar.
The month selector is the browser's native input type=month.
The activate/deactivate (Power) button has no data-testid.

action_items: On surgery delete (and cancel), delete or void the anesthesia_records doc for that surgery_id, but only if its month is not closed
Fill the surgery form 'Tipo de anestesia' options from /api/quirofano/anesthesia/types (active ones), or at least warn when a type has no fee
Remove the remaining supply cost UI (Unitario/Total/TOTAL/Total insumos, and the table INSUMOS column) as the spec says
Fix 'Mes cerrado (pagado)' badge contrast; add data-testid to the anesthesia type toggle button
Decide whether to skip 'N/A' anesthesiologist records in the closure
critical_code_review_comments: SalaOperaciones.js is 1730 lines; split the detail and dialogs into components
Supply select sets category = catalog note (it?.note || 'otro'), so category is free text with no validation
Catalog select uses name as the value; two catalog items with the same name would collide. Use the id as the value

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 related backend bug found

seed_data_creation: Catalog insumo 'TEST_Insumo_<ts>_ED' (inactive); anesthesia type 'TEST_Local_<ts>' Q450 (inactive); month 2026-10 CLOSED; Diego Armando Castillo supplies_status=registrados plus Viscoelástico x2 and Facoemulsificador x1 added; TEST surgery created and deleted (orphan anesthesia record removed manually).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2026-10 anesthesia month is closed (reopen via superadmin API if needed). 2026-11 closure baseline is Q2,500 (6 records). Use window.confirm auto-accept (import asyncio) for the close-month button. The surgery form save button is 'Guardar registro'.
rca of the issue: routes/surgeries.py delete_surgery only calls db.surgeries.delete_one; upsert_anesthesia_from_surgery is called only on create/update, and nothing removes anesthesia_records on delete/cancel. Fix: in delete/cancel, call await db.anesthesia_records.delete_many({'surgery_id': id}) (or mark it voided), guarded by _month_closed.
